760140101.text: Hmm, looks like this way is blocked...

760140201.text: Wow, it's so deep! Looks like there's an even bigger space down below!

760140202.text: ...Hey! You two, are you trying to get yourselves killed?

760140203.text: Don't just stand there! Get over here and keep your voice down!

760140204.text: Waaah! You scared Paimon! She didn't expect to find anyone else in a place like this... And w—why are you hiding?

760140205.text: ...Shh! I told you to keep quiet, buddy!

760140206.text: But judging by your chubby looks... Hah, you wouldn't happen to be the daughter of some Northland fae lord, would you?

760140207.text: Hey, what do you mean by "chubby looks"!? Paimon's not chubby at all! And Paimon's not fae either!

760140209.text: #That's right. {M#He}{F#She}'s {NICKNAME}, and Paimon's Paimon, {M#his}{F#her} guide! We saw this deep pit and came here to investigate!

760140213.text: Yes, yes, of course. You're adventurers, definitely not nobility. We all need to wear some masks, am I right?

760140214.text: But since you've all introduced yourselves, I should, for my part, do as decorum dictates. Maite Veliu, heir to the legendary thief Reed Miller. Don't worry, that's my real name.

760140211.text: Feign what? And who is Miss Paimonovna anyway?

760140212.text: #In any case, {M#he}{F#she} is {NICKNAME}, and Paimon's {M#his}{F#her} guide! We're adventurers who've come to investigate this deep pit!

760140301.text: This way is blocked too, buddy. *sigh* If only we had abilities like those Frostmoon weirdos do...

subQuests.subQuestName: Catch up to the Crab Tsar

760140401.text: Huh? Looks like there's no way forward... Where did that big crab escape to?

760140402.text: *sigh* This is a problem. These mirrors were left behind by those Frostmoon weirdos. Only they and the Crab Tsar can travel through them...

760140403.text: Um, so that big crab actually went inside the mirrors? It's just a crab, so where did it learn how to do that?

760140404.text: Well, it probably has something to do with that cursed st{RUBY#[D]Twardowska's Stone}one of desire.

760140405.text: *ahem* Better find a wall first, buddy, in case you fall over from what I'm about to tell you! I, Maite Veliu, am actually a member of the Conch Gang, here to gather intel—

760140407.text: Hm? What's with that reaction... Have you heard of us before?

760140411.text: Anyway, forget about that for now. Just so you know, I've been observing this place for quite some time already.

760140412.text: Truth is, His Majesty the Crab Tsar used to be quite docile, and it couldn't travel through these mirrors either — that is, until recently, when it found that stone from who-knows-where...

760140413.text: By which I mean that big stone you saw it carrying on its back. Since then, its temperament has taken a... particularly deadly turn.

760140414.text: Evil, cruel, easily agitated... Sometimes it even uses its pincers to crush other little crabs, turning this place upside down...

760140415.text: Wait, so the "treasure" you're looking for is actually the stone on its back! No wonder you say we'll have to defeat it first...

760140416.text: Heh heh, that's right, buddy! According to the stories, Lovia, High Priestess of the Frost Moon, was also once bewitched by one such stone of desire five hundred years ago.

760140417.text: The desperate pleas of Lady Aila moved the master thief Reed Miller to steal that cursed stone, and he captured her heart in the process — why else would she have remained unmarried for life?

760140418.text: ...I see. Is this what you wish for, Ruler of "Elysium"?

760140420.text: *cough* No, I—I wasn't scared! I'm the heir of the legendary thief Reed Miller, I... Anyway, identify yourself, now!

760140421.text: Whoa! Y—You're that priestess who appeared near Thunderclap Reef earlier! Uh, Verna said you were a fake, though...

760140409.text: R—Run? Wait, what's so scary about that!? Also, what kinda corny reaction is that? And who is Miss Paimonovna anyway?

760140410.text: Hah, it's normal to react that way when you hear our name. But don't worry buddy, I'm not your enemy.

subQuests.subQuestName: Catch up to the Crab Tsar

760140503.text: Whoa, it's the priestess from before!

760140504.text: Uh, we weren't exactly looking for you, but... Who are you really?

760140505.text: It's always like this, always... Promising to take me away, then always leaving me behind...

760140506.text: This time is no different... Asking those questions just to give me false hope so I would stay, waiting for a salvation that will never come... isn't that right?

760140507.text: No, that's not what we meant! Please don't cry... We're adventurers, and we love helping others. If you need help with anything, just tell us...

760140603.text: Whoa, it's the purple-haired priestess! She's appeared out of nowhere again!

760140604.text: Um, you... could say we came to find you. You didn't reveal your identity earlier when Verna was here... Now it's just us, so you can say anything you want!

760140605.text: Like, you could talk about the whole deal with this "Court of the First Edict"... You said you'd be waiting for us there, so how come you're here?

760140606.text: ...Guiding the prophesied Ruler of "Elysium" is our mission in the sublunary sphere...

760140607.text: ...I know who you are and what you want. I can see the threads of fate woven by moonlight, so... stop pursuing me. It is pointless...

760140608.text: It's always like this, always... Promising to take me away, then always leaving me behind...

760140609.text: This time is no different... Asking those questions just to give me false hope so I would stay, waiting for a salvation that will never come... isn't that right?

760142102.text: Alright, let's do this! Time to show that fellow what a proper, no holds barred frontal sneak attack looks like!

760142103.text: Right! A frontal sneak atta— Wait, can you even call it a sneak attack if we do it from the front!?

760141601.text: I don't think she's a good person.

760141602.text: Yeah, she talks weirdly and avoids our questions. She's got a real scary look on her face, too. Maybe she's the one who turned the crab into this...

760141604.text: Well, buddy, how's it going? Have you calmed down?

760141605.text: *sigh* Seems like it's hiding away out of regret, after all the terrible things it did to the little crabs while under the stone's influence.

760141607.text: It's alright. Let it reflect on its actions for now. Those who do bad things must be punished — this is the fate of all evil rulers.

760141608.text: Still, Paimon didn't expect that stone to fly away like that...

760141609.text: Well, it's not a bad thing. If it had actually circulated on the market, it might have hurt even more people.

760141610.text: Here, have this too. Now that His Majesty the Tsar has become docile once more, my observation notes are complete.

760141611.text: And from now on, you're a friend of the Conch Gang. When you dine at the Speranza Restaurant in Nasha Town, just mention the name Maite...

760141612.text: And I'll get my meal on the house?

760141613.text: ...No, I don't have that kind of pull yet. You'll still need to settle your bills with Big Sis Katya.

760141614.text: Huh? What's the point of mentioning your name, then!?

760141615.text: O—Of course there's a point! If Big Sis Katya's in a good mood, she might even buy you all drinks or something...

760141616.text: So it still depends on someone else's mood!

760141617.text: *whimper* Th—Then, even if she isn't feeling up to it, I'll still buy you drinks... No, I'll treat you to a meal! I'll have to work a few days for the funds, though...

760141618.text: *cough* A promise is a promise, and one good turn deserves another — that's the rule set by the legendary Reed Miller! So take this IOU, buddy!

760141301.text: Hah! Nowhere left to run now, huh?

760141302.text: I know these grounds like the back of my hand, and I can tell you we've got it cornered. Once we take it down here, this will all be over.
